name: National Equipment Co
old_description: National Equipment is the only locally owned and leading foodservice equipment and suppliers in West Virginia. We have been serving the region for 80 years! No job is too large or complicated for our team. When you come into one of our showrooms, you will be received by our courteous and knowledgeable staff. Our sales team and technicians are on the road every day to keep your business running smoothly.
about:
National Equipment Company operates showrooms in Wheeling and Morgantown, West Virginia. The locally owned distributor has served the region’s foodservice industry for over 80 years, though a precise founding year is not publicly disclosed. The business began as a supplier of commercial kitchen equipment and has remained under local ownership.

The company distributes a broad range of foodservice equipment and smallwares, carrying brands such as Browne Foodservice and TableCraft Products. Its services extend beyond sales to include on-site installation oversight, equipment testing, and ongoing maintenance for walk-in coolers, commercial refrigeration, cooking equipment, exhaust fans, steamers, ice makers, dishwashers, slicers, mixers, and countertop units. Technicians on staff hold a combined 80 years of experience in installation and service. Emergency repair service is offered on weekends.

Customers span restaurants, bars, concession stands, institutional kitchens, and other foodservice operations throughout West Virginia. Product categories cover beverage and bar supplies, chef apparel, cleaning and facility products, cooking equipment, dishwashing equipment, disposables, food display, food preparation, furniture, ice machines, plumbing, refrigeration, smallwares, storage, and tabletop items.

National Equipment emphasizes its status as the only locally owned leading supplier in the state, with technicians who oversee every installation and provide weekend emergency support. The company’s showrooms allow hands-on product evaluation, and its sales and service teams travel daily to keep client operations running.
